_ordering_rationale: Segments geographiques Ralph Lauren : North America (coeur historique), Europe (croissance pricing), Asia (relais croissance majeur), Licensing (marge tres elevee). Fiscal year se termine fin mars.

kpis.signal: Stabilisation post-recovery, focus brand elevation et reduction promotions wholesale
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues segment North America : retail (stores + digital) + wholesale department stores + outlets. Coeur historique Ralph Lauren, strategie d elevation des prix et reduction des promotions.
kpis.description_en: North America segment net revenues: retail (stores + digital) + wholesale department stores + outlets. Ralph Lauren historical core, brand elevation and promo reduction strategy.

kpis.signal: Meilleure croissance, traction full-price stores et tourisme high-end
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues segment Europe : retail + wholesale dans les pays europeens. Croissance soutenue portee par tourist spending, expansion full-price stores et premiumisation marque.
kpis.description_en: Europe segment net revenues: retail + wholesale in European countries. Strong growth driven by tourist spending, full-price store expansion and brand premiumization.

kpis.signal: Relais croissance majeur, expansion Chine continentale et Coree
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues segment Asia : retail + wholesale Chine continentale, Japon, Coree du Sud, Asie du Sud-Est, Australie. Relais croissance majeur, expansion magasins full-price et e-commerce.
kpis.description_en: Asia segment net revenues: retail + wholesale Mainland China, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, Australia. Major growth driver, full-price store expansion and e-commerce.

kpis.signal: Declin structurel, repris en interne certains accords, mais tres haute marge
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues Other = essentiellement licensing : royalties sur eyewear, fragrances, accessoires, home. Marge brute proche de 100%. Declin reflete reprise en interne de certaines categories.
kpis.description_en: Other net revenues = mostly licensing: royalties on eyewear, fragrances, accessories, home. Near 100% gross margin. Decline reflects internalization of some categories.
